reason: A DSH web UI customization plugin focused on typography, table styling, dialog layout, navigation panels, Git integration, archive management, MCP management, and an optional project initialization command.

summaries.zh: 用于调整 DSH 对话界面样式与布局，并提供可选的时间线、Git 状态栏、归档管理、MCP 管理和项目初始化命令。
summaries.en: A DSH web UI plugin for customizing chat styling and layout with optional timeline, Git status, archive, MCP management, and project initialization features.

capabilities: Adjusts chat typography, table styling, and dialog width
Adds an optional conversation timeline and Git status interface
Reads and modifies Git branches, diffs, commits, and pushes changes
Restores or permanently deletes archived sessions
Manages MCP server configurations and runtime state
Generates an AGENTS.md prompt for the current project
